title: A Hilbert feature potential has a controlled tangent Riesz field
source_anchor: Samplinglib original feature differentiation and transport supplement v1, 2026-10-21; units[2] and its complete formula proof
target_statement: Let E,H be complete real inner-product normed spaces. Let F:E→H be a map, and let each D(w):E→H be a continuous real linear map satisfying the actual ambient identity DF(w)=D(w) for every w. Suppose M₁,M₂≥0, ‖D(w)‖op≤M₁ on the closed unit ball, and ‖D(w)−D(u)‖op≤M₂‖w−u‖ there. For r∈H define V_r(w)=2⟨r,F(w)⟩ and G_r(w)=2(D(w)*r−⟨D(w)*r,w⟩w), where * is the Hilbert adjoint. At every ambient w, V_r has derivative 2⟨D(w)*r,·⟩. At every unit w, G_r(w) is tangent, satisfies ⟨G_r(w),v⟩=2⟨r,D(w)v⟩ for every v perpendicular to w, and has norm at most 2M₁‖r‖. For all r,q and unit w,u, its joint increment is bounded by 2M₁‖r−q‖+2(M₂+2M₁)‖q‖‖w−u‖.
